_about: Live framing hints (CoachCore FramingHint raw values). Seeded by the App shell; owned by the Capture (LiveFraming) agent from now on.

framing.hint.backlight.comment: Live framing hint: the picture is too dark or too bright.

framing.hint.move_closer.comment: Live framing hint: the player is too small in the frame.

framing.hint.show_feet.comment: Live framing hint: ankles are not visible.

framing.hint.step_back.comment: Live framing hint while recording: the player fills too much of the frame (DESIGN.md §5.4 step 0).
